zh_summary: 非常糟糕的建議：PEG 是穩健複利者的工具。對於週期股，你要看你在週期中的位置，正常化/中週期盈利、市淨率、產能、庫存、利差，而不是美化高峰並懲罰低谷的增長倍數。在週期股上使用 PEG 就像用平均高度判斷過山車。
text:
Very bad advice: PEG is a tool for steady compounders. For cyclicals, you look at where you are in the cycle—normalized/mid-cycle earnings, price-to-book, capacity, inventory, spreads—not a growth multiple that flatters the peak and punishes the trough. Using PEG on a cyclical is like judging a rollercoaster by its average height: technically true, practically useless.  PEG doesn't work for cyclicals because it assumes earnings growth is smooth and predictable—cyclical earnings are neither.
 
Here's the simple version:
• PEG = P/E ÷ growth rate. It's designed for companies whose earnings grow steadily year after year (like software or consumer staples). A low PEG is supposed to mean "cheap growth."
• Cyclical earnings swing wildly—autos, steel, airlines, semis, energy. In a boom, earnings spike and the P/E looks low. In a bust, earnings collapse and the P/E looks high (or goes negative).
• So PEG gets it backwards. At the top of the cycle, when the stock is actually most dangerous, trailing growth looks great and PEG looks cheap. At the bottom, when the stock may be cheapest, earnings are troughing, growth looks terrible, and PEG looks expensive—or meaningless.
• The "G" is unreliable. A cyclical's growth rate over the past few years tells you almost nothing about the next few, because it's driven by the cycle, not by a durable compounding engine. You're dividing by a number that's about to reverse.

text:
FSD v15 is starting to hit cars today, and I think this is a really BIG one.

Elon says the wider release is coming in December with the holiday update, calling it “something special.” This is the first wave, so if your car hasn’t received it yet, that’s normal fyi. 

The number everyone’s going to talk about is 25x.

Tesla says it's “25x better handling of safety critical cases,” while the release notes describe a 25x improvement in the critical intervention rate... that’s about situations where a driver needs to step in for safety. 

Tesla upgraded the vision encoder, the part of the AI that makes sense of what the cameras see. It’s shared with Robotaxi and Optimus, and Tesla says it was trained on millions of internet videos to help it understand more situations and learn more efficiently. A core piece of how the car, the robotaxi and the robot understand the world is now shared.

Then there’s Tesla Reality View.

The familiar gray driving display is now being replaced by a detailed view of the world around the car, created live from a virtual viewpoint above it. Ashok says the same model that drives the car also draws that scene. Arrows show the turns FSD plans to make, and pins show where it wants to park. 

Elon says you can tap a point in that view to tell the car where to go, with turn markers floating overhead like a video game. 

He says, “It’s like GTA" and the new visualization uses less computing power than the old one.
